title: Why it sucks being a striker

scenes.text: Why it sucks being a striker.
It starts when you're six. You score ten goals a game. Everyone loves you.
Age nine. The other team finds out. Now three defenders follow you everywhere.
Age eleven. You score twice. You miss one easy chance. In the car, your dad only talks about the miss.
Age thirteen. Eighty minutes. Nobody passes to you. Not once. Coach: "Why aren't you involved?"
Age fifteen. Last minute. Penalty. Everyone is watching. You hit the bar.
Age sixteen. Hat-trick! Next week, you don't score. "Flop." "Bench him." "Sell him."
Age seventeen. You finally score the winner. You run to the fans... Offside.
That's the thing about being a striker. Everyone else is judged on ninety minutes.
Tag your striker. Tell them: the next one goes in.
